source_refs.note: Exercise 5.1 (book p. 154), Question 9; answer key PDF 306 (Answers 5.1, key numbered 11).

blocks.prompt: 9 (i) Find the family of lines through the point of intersection of the lines \(2x - 3y + 5 = 0\), \(x + 4y - 7 = 0\). Find the member of the family which is parallel to \(y = 2x + 1\).
blocks.explanation:
Do lines ke intersection point se guzarne wali saari lines ki family \(\ell_1 + k\ell_2 = 0\) hai.
Humein us family ka woh member chahiye jo ek aur shart poori kare: \(y = 2x + 1\) ke parallel ho (slope \(2\)).
Intersection point nikalne ki zaroorat nahi; family khud us point ka khayal rakhti hai.
Plan: family, us ki slope \(k\) mein, slope ki shart se \(k\), phir wapas family mein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(2x - 3y + 5 = 0\) aur \(x + 4y - 7 = 0\).
Maloom karna: in ke intersection point se family, aur us ka woh member jo \(y = 2x + 1\) ke parallel ho (slope \(2\)).
Tareeqa: \(\ell_1 + k\ell_2 = 0\) (Section 5.5, Example 11), phir slope ki shart.
Yeh sawal bhi Example 11 aur sawal 8 jaisa hai; tareeqa wohi, sirf lines badli hain.

Family
\[2x - 3y + 5 + k(x + 4y - 7) = 0\]
\[(2 + k)x + (-3 + 4k)y + (5 - 7k) = 0\]
Kyun: \(\ell_1 + k\ell_2 = 0\) ki har line meeting point se guzarti hai; \(x\), \(y\) aur constant terms ikatthe kiye. (Answer key \(k\) ki jagah \(\lambda\) likhti hai, farq sirf naam ka hai.)
Yahan bhi \(k\) se meeting point ke gird ghoomne wali lines milti hain; slope 2 wali position chunni hai.

Family ki slope
\[m = -\dfrac{2 + k}{4k - 3}\]
Kyun: \(ax + by + c = 0\) ki slope \(-\frac{a}{b}\) hoti hai; yahan \(a\) aur \(b\) dono \(k\) par depend karte hain.

Shart lagayein
\[-\dfrac{2 + k}{4k - 3} = 2\]
\[-2 - k = 8k - 6\]
\[9k = 4\]
\[k = \dfrac{4}{9}\]
Kyun: parallel lines ki slopes barabar hoti hain; cross-multiply kar ke \(k\) ki simple equation ban gayi.
Dhyan dein: y = 2x + 1 ki slope seedha x ka coefficient 2 hai, kyunke yeh pehle se y = mx + c ki shakal mein hai.

\(k = \frac{4}{9}\) ko family mein rakhein
\[\tfrac{22}{9}x + \left(-3 + \tfrac{16}{9}\right)y + \left(5 - \tfrac{28}{9}\right) = 0\]
\[\tfrac{22}{9}x - \tfrac{11}{9}y + \tfrac{17}{9} = 0\]
\[22x - 11y + 17 = 0\]
Kyun: har coefficient mein \(k\) ki value rakhi, phir fractions khatam karne ke liye multiply kiya aur saada shakal banai.
Pehle 9 se multiply kiya (sab denominators 9 the); \(x\) ka coefficient 22 aur \(y\) ka \(-11\) aaya, slope \(\frac{22}{11} = 2\), bilkul jo chahiye tha.

Tasdeeq:
Slope \(\frac{22}{11} = 2\), sahi. Di hui lines \(\left(\frac{1}{11}, \frac{19}{11}\right)\) par milti hain, aur \(22\left(\frac{1}{11}\right) - 11\left(\frac{19}{11}\right) + 17 = 2 - 19 + 17 = 0\). Answer key 11(i) se milta hai.

blocks.prompt: 9 (ii) Find the family of lines through the point of intersection of the lines \(2x - 3y + 5 = 0\), \(x + 4y - 7 = 0\). Find the member of the family which is perpendicular to \(y = x\).
blocks.explanation:
Do lines ke intersection point se guzarne wali saari lines ki family \(\ell_1 + k\ell_2 = 0\) hai.
Humein us family ka woh member chahiye jo ek aur shart poori kare: \(y = x\) par perpendicular ho (us ki slope \(1\), is liye humein slope \(-1\) chahiye).
Intersection point nikalne ki zaroorat nahi; family khud us point ka khayal rakhti hai.
Plan: family, us ki slope \(k\) mein, slope ki shart se \(k\), phir wapas family mein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(2x - 3y + 5 = 0\) aur \(x + 4y - 7 = 0\).
Maloom karna: in ke intersection point se family, aur us ka woh member jo \(y = x\) par perpendicular ho (us ki slope \(1\), is liye humein slope \(-1\) chahiye).
Tareeqa: \(\ell_1 + k\ell_2 = 0\) (Section 5.5, Example 11), phir slope ki shart.
Ab shart perpendicular hone ki hai; y = x ki slope 1 hai, to humein slope minus 1 chahiye.

Family
\[2x - 3y + 5 + k(x + 4y - 7) = 0\]
\[(2 + k)x + (-3 + 4k)y + (5 - 7k) = 0\]
Kyun: \(\ell_1 + k\ell_2 = 0\) ki har line meeting point se guzarti hai; \(x\), \(y\) aur constant terms ikatthe kiye. (Answer key \(k\) ki jagah \(\lambda\) likhti hai, farq sirf naam ka hai.)

Family ki slope
\[m = -\dfrac{2 + k}{4k - 3}\]
Kyun: \(ax + by + c = 0\) ki slope \(-\frac{a}{b}\) hoti hai; yahan \(a\) aur \(b\) dono \(k\) par depend karte hain.

Shart lagayein
\[-\dfrac{2 + k}{4k - 3} \times 1 = -1\]
\[2 + k = 4k - 3\]
\[3k = 5\]
\[k = \dfrac{5}{3}\]
Kyun: perpendicular lines ke liye \(m_1m_2 = -1\); cross-multiply kar ke \(k\) ki simple equation ban gayi.
Dhyan dein: \(y = x\) ki slope 1 hai, is liye perpendicular slope \(-1\) hai. Answer key ne isi jagah ghalti ki hai: us ki line ki slope \(+1\) hai, yani woh \(y = x\) ke parallel hai.

\(k = \frac{5}{3}\) ko family mein rakhein
\[\tfrac{11}{3}x + \left(-3 + \tfrac{20}{3}\right)y + \left(5 - \tfrac{35}{3}\right) = 0\]
\[\tfrac{11}{3}x + \tfrac{11}{3}y - \tfrac{20}{3} = 0\]
\[11x + 11y - 20 = 0\]
Kyun: har coefficient mein \(k\) ki value rakhi, phir fractions khatam karne ke liye multiply kiya aur saada shakal banai.
Pehle 3 se multiply kiya; teeno coefficients 11, 11 aur minus 20 aaye. x aur y ke coefficients barabar hain, is liye slope minus 1 hai, jo humein chahiye tha.

Tasdeeq:
Slope \(-\frac{11}{11} = -1\) aur \((-1)(1) = -1\), yani perpendicular. \(\left(\frac{1}{11}, \frac{19}{11}\right)\) par: \(1 + 19 - 20 = 0\), yani line meeting point se guzarti hai.
Yeh tasdeeq bahut zaroori thi, kyunke isi se pata chala ke answer key ka jawab ghalat hai (neeche dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key (Answers 5.1, number 11 (ii)) mein \(11x - 11y + 20 = 0\) chhapa hai. Is line ki slope \(+1\) hai, yani yeh \(y = x\) ke parallel hai, perpendicular nahi; aur yeh intersection point se bhi nahi guzarti: \(11\left(\frac{1}{11}\right) - 11\left(\frac{19}{11}\right) + 20 = 2 \ne 0\). Sahi jawab \(11x + 11y - 20 = 0\) hai.
